```{=html}
<style>
#demo { --w: #191A4A; --c: #ED7532; --ink: #1d1d1f; --ink2: #55565c; --muted: #8a8b91; --grid: #e8e8e5; --surface: #fcfcfb; --june: #a9aab0; }
  #demo h1 { font-size: 1.45rem; margin: 0 0 .25rem; }
  #demo .sub { color: var(--ink2); margin: 0 0 .6rem; max-width: 52rem; }
  #demo .lead { font-size: 1rem; margin: .4rem 0 .8rem; max-width: 52rem; }
  #demo .legend { display: flex; gap: 1.3rem; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--ink2); margin: .3rem 0 1rem; align-items: center; }
  #demo .sw { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; margin-right: .35rem; vertical-align: -1px; }
  #demo .ln { display: inline-block; width: 22px; height: 0; border-top: 2px solid; margin-right: .35rem; vertical-align: 3px; }
  #demo .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 14px 18px; }
  @media (max-width: 900px) { #demo .grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
  @media (max-width: 520px) { #demo .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  #demo .panel h3 { font-size: .92rem; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; }
  #demo .panel .stat { font-size: .78rem; color: var(--ink2); margin: .05rem 0 .15rem; min-height: 2.1em; }
  #demo svg text { font-family: inherit; }
  #demo .lab { fill: var(--muted); font-size: 10.5px; }
  #demo .gl { stroke: var(--grid); stroke-width: 1; }
  #demo .half { stroke: #c9c9c4; stroke-width: 1; }
  #demo .note { color: var(--muted); font-size: .82rem; margin-top: 1.1rem; max-width: 60rem; }
  #tip { position: fixed; pointer-events: none; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--grid); border-radius: 6px; padding: .4rem .55rem; font-size: .8rem;
         box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08); display: none; max-width: 240px; }
  #demo details summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink2); font-size: .88rem; margin-top: .8rem; }
  #demo table { border-collapse: collapse; font-size: .84rem; margin-top: .4rem; }
  #demo td, #demo th { padding: .2rem .6rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--grid); text-align: right; } td:first-child, th:first-child { text-align: left; }
#demo { color: var(--ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
#demo h1 { font-size: 1.45rem; }
</style>
<div id="demo">
<p><a href="./">Back to the CA-11 needle</a></p>

  
  <p class="sub" id="sub"></p>
  <p class="lead" id="lead"></p>
  <div class="legend">
    <span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--w);opacity:.7"></span>Precinct Wiener leads</span>
    <span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--c);opacity:.8"></span>Precinct Chan leads</span>
    <span><span class="ln" style="border-color:var(--ink)"></span>Tonight, vote-weighted fit</span>
    <span><span class="ln" style="border-color:var(--june)"></span>June primary, same precincts and ballot type</span>
    <span>Dot size: votes counted</span>
  </div>
  <div class="grid" id="grid"></div>
  <details><summary>Show the fits as a table</summary><table id="tbl"></table></details>
  <p class="note">Demographics use 2020 Census blocks and ACS 2019-2023 block groups mapped to 2022 precincts by registration. Data for Boudin recall is taken from the June 2022 vote and mapped onto current precinct boundaries. Precincts with fewer than 50 votes counted are omitted.</p>

<div id="tip"></div>
</div>
<script>

(async function () {
  const override = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("data");
  const URL_ = override || "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacharylhertz/needle-ca11/main/data/live/demographics.json";
  const D = await (await fetch(URL_, { cache: "no-store" })).json();
  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", W = "#191A4A", C = "#ED7532", INK = "#1d1d1f", JUNE = "#a9aab0";
  const tip = document.getElementById("tip");
  const el = (t, a, p) => { const e = document.createElementNS(NS, t); for (const k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]); if (p) p.appendChild(e); return e; };
  const tx = (s, a, p) => { const e = el("text", a, p); e.textContent = s; return e; };
  const show = (h, ev) => { tip.innerHTML = h; tip.style.display = "block"; tip.style.left = Math.min(ev.clientX + 14, innerWidth - 260) + "px"; tip.style.top = (ev.clientY + 14) + "px"; };
  const hide = () => tip.style.display = "none";
  const sg = v => (v >= 0 ? "+" : "−") + Math.abs(v).toFixed(1);
  const when = new Date(D.updated).toLocaleTimeString("en-US", { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", timeZone: "America/Los_Angeles" });
  document.getElementById("sub").textContent = "I plot the relationship between precinct-level demographics in CA-11 and Scott Wiener’s share of the vote. Data in this release is current as of " +
    when + " PT, with " + D.counted.toLocaleString() + " votes counted so far.";
  document.getElementById("lead").textContent = "Right now, not much appears to have shifted from the June primary. Currently, Wiener has " + D.city.toFixed(1) +
    "% of the vote citywide. In most cases this looks more like an intercept shift, where there was essentially a uniform slight shift away from Wiener since June. " +
    "The correlation coefficient, r, tells us the strength of the relationship between a given demographic characteristic and support for Wiener in the November vote. " +
    "The light grey line plots the linear relationship in the June primary comparing only Wiener against Chan.";
  const grid = document.getElementById("grid"), tbl = document.getElementById("tbl");
  tbl.innerHTML = "<tr><th>Measure</th><th>r tonight</th><th>r June</th><th>Pts per 10 tonight</th><th>Pts per 10 June</th></tr>";
  D.panels.forEach(P => {
    const div = document.createElement("div"); div.className = "panel"; grid.appendChild(div);
    const h = document.createElement("h3"); h.textContent = P.label; div.appendChild(h);
    const unit = P.key === "median_income" ? "$10k" : "10 points";
    const st = document.createElement("p"); st.className = "stat";
    st.textContent = `r = ${P.nov.r.toFixed(2)} · ${sg(10 * P.nov.b)} pts per ${unit} (June ${sg(10 * P.jun.b)})`;
    div.appendChild(st);
    const w = 260, hgt = 190, L = 28, R = 6, T = 6, B = 22;
    const svg = el("svg", { viewBox: `0 0 ${w} ${hgt}`, role: "img", "aria-label": P.label + ": Wiener share by precinct" }, div); svg.style.width = "100%";
    const xs = P.pts.map(p => p.x); let lo = Math.min(...xs), hi = Math.max(...xs); if (P.key !== "median_income") { lo = Math.max(0, Math.floor(lo / 10) * 10); hi = Math.min(100, Math.ceil(hi / 10) * 10); }
    const X = v => L + (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * (w - L - R), Y = v => T + (100 - Math.max(20, Math.min(90, v))) / 70 * (hgt - T - B);
    [20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90].forEach(v => { el("line", { x1: L, x2: w - R, y1: Y(v), y2: Y(v), class: v === 50 ? "half" : "gl" }, svg); if (v % 20 === 10 || v === 50) tx(v + "%", { x: L - 4, y: Y(v) + 3.5, "text-anchor": "end", class: "lab" }, svg); });
    for (let k = 0; k <= 4; k++) { const v = lo + k * (hi - lo) / 4; tx(P.key === "median_income" ? "$" + Math.round(v) + "k" : Math.round(v) + "%", { x: X(v), y: hgt - 6, "text-anchor": k === 0 ? "start" : k === 4 ? "end" : "middle", class: "lab" }, svg); }
    const vmax = Math.max(...P.pts.map(p => p.v));
    P.pts.slice().sort((a, b) => b.v - a.v).forEach(p => {
      const c = el("circle", { cx: X(p.x), cy: Y(p.y), r: 1.2 + 3.6 * Math.sqrt(p.v / vmax), fill: p.y >= 50 ? W : C, "fill-opacity": p.y >= 50 ? .45 : .6 }, svg);
      c.addEventListener("mousemove", ev => show(`<b>Precinct ${p.p}</b>${p.n ? " · " + p.n : ""}<br>${P.label}: ${P.key === "median_income" ? "$" + Math.round(p.x) + "k" : p.x.toFixed(0) + "%"}<br>Wiener ${p.y.toFixed(1)}% tonight · ${p.j.toFixed(1)}% in June<br>${p.v} votes`, ev));
      c.addEventListener("mouseleave", hide);
    });
    [[P.jun, JUNE], [P.nov, INK]].forEach(([f, col]) => el("line", { x1: X(lo), y1: Y(f.a + f.b * lo), x2: X(hi), y2: Y(f.a + f.b * hi), stroke: col, "stroke-width": 2, "stroke-linecap": "round" }, svg));
    tbl.innerHTML += `<tr><td>${P.label}</td><td>${P.nov.r.toFixed(2)}</td><td>${P.jun.r.toFixed(2)}</td><td>${sg(10 * P.nov.b)}</td><td>${sg(10 * P.jun.b)}</td></tr>`;
  });
})();

</script>
```
